notablePrerequisites:
Scytheclaw attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with Scytheclaw attached.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Scytheclaw attached.
Scytheclaw triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
